weather.note: Home 'location' + 'lat'/'lon' is used by default. Add entries to 'travel' with 'location', 'lat', 'lon', and 'end' (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive) while away; an optional 'start' date lets you pre-schedule future trips. If you omit lat/lon, the agent will geocode via Open-Meteo's /v1/search endpoint — but pre-caching coords skips a round-trip on the hot path. The agent auto-reverts to home once 'end' passes, so expired entries are harmless — delete them at your leisure.

notion.note: Requires Notion MCP connected at claude.ai/settings/connectors

discord_webhook.note: Leave url empty — the webhook URL is passed via the trigger's bootstrap prompt so it stays out of the repo

email.note: Requires email MCP connector (e.g. Resend) at claude.ai/settings/connectors

sms.note: Requires Twilio or similar MCP connector at claude.ai/settings/connectors
